scope: local-only backup manifest and isolated restore qualification
claims: Backup manifests require the exact version-1 top-level and per-file fields.
Malformed timestamps, duplicate paths, malformed byte counts and digests, and missing core database/platform entries fail closed.
Manifest rejection occurs before the isolated restore destination is created.
The restored database is still checked with SQLite PRAGMA quick_check after copying into the isolated destination.
limitations: This evidence does not perform off-host retention, staging restore, production rollback, signing, upload, deployment, or activation.
A crash or filesystem error during the copy phase can still leave an incomplete isolated destination; atomic restore promotion remains future local hardening work.
